{{Top|leg}}
'''Naboo shellfish''' was an [[Foodstuff/Legends|appetizer dish]] that was sautéed in [[Butter/Legends|butter]] made from [[blue cream]]. One of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]]'s favorite appetizers, the [[Shellfish/Legends|shellfish]] was served at the [[Indigo Tower]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and shared its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
